messages:
lena: FYI team: next week's infra change will enable SAML enforcement org-wide and kick off a CI auth sweep. Date: 2026-04-07 01:30 UTC. Expect brief token expirations for older integrations. Full post: https://redwood.internal/security/saml-enforce-2026
chuck: Does this mean personal browser sessions will break or just machine/service tokens?
bryan: And what about our old Jenkins cluster and the fleet of self-hosted runners? We still have some using legacy PATs.
lena: Good Qs. Short answers:
  - Personal sessions: you may be asked to re-auth for SAML flows; session cookies should be fine until they expire.
  - Service tokens/PATs: these will be flagged and rolled where possible; anything we can rotate centrally (GitHub Apps, org-integrations) will be rotated. Manual action needed for PATs in repos or external services.
okta-bot: Notice: SAML enforcement toggle scheduled for 2026-04-07T01:30:00Z by infra/saml-team (owner: lena).
ci-bot: CI Sweep job queued: infra/ci-auth-sweep v2. Details: https://redwood.internal/ops/ci-sweep. Estimated run time: 25m. Will create per-repo PRs for detected PATs when possible.
bryan: If PRs are created to replace PATs with app auth, will they include testing changes? Last time they changed GH actions and broke a couple workflows.
lena: PRs will include a `ci-auth-migration.md` in the repo with the exact change and a smoke-step. We will not merge automatically for repos flagged as high-risk; repo owners will be pinged.
chuck: Can we get a list of flagged repos so we can triage? Also, any immediate mitigations for external services that accept PATs?
ci-bot: Export posted: https://redwood.internal/sheets/ci-auth-flagged-2026-04. Owners column included. External services: recommend swapping to OAuth apps where possible; we have a small support doc with examples.
lena: Please follow this quick prep checklist before Wed:
  1) Run: `gh auth status` and `gh secret list --repo <org>/<repo>` to locate stored PATs.
  2) For repos with PATs, add a `migration-issue` and assign the repo owner (sheet has owners).
  3) Self-hosted runners: update to runner image `redwood/runner:202604` which includes SSO helper hooks.
  4) Join troubleshooting office hours Tue 2026-04-06 17:00 PT (link in post).
bryan: I'll start triaging the flagged list and open issues for the highest-traffic services.
chuck: I'll coordinate with platform to ensure the Jenkins connector gets an OAuth app before the toggle.
dev-rel: Heads-up for external partners: if you integrate with our webhooks using PATs, we'll reach out with migration steps. Expect emails from partner-relations next week.
lena: We'll monitor auth-error rates and have a fallback window (toggle off) if we see >3% 401s for 15m on core infra. Ping me or open #incident-auth if anything odd. Thanks all :rocket:
